page.overview:
Who is Dame Morgaine?

Dame Morgaine is one of the hounds of the King of Timmony. As an NPC, she is played by Brennan Lee Mulligan.

Morgaine is a beautiful mountain herding dog similar to a collie with black, white, and brown fur in splotches, as well as an unusual shade of deep, rich blue..}}

The dame is a professional and polite individual, very formal, although with occasional moments of casualness.

The souls of the Hounds of the King were once knights of Timmony fighting for their homeland against the gods in the Shapers' War, who swore an oath to defend their king in this world and the next. After their deaths, with no afterlife to receive them, they learned from the Druids of the Stag that souls can return many times to the world. The Hounds asked to return and serve a king once more, and were reborn in their dog forms.
